## NSXL for Windows 1.3.7

**Controllers**
- PS5 and PS4 controllers keep working in NSXL after you play a game. Once a game or Steam switches the controller into its full mode, Windows stops passing it to NSXL. NSXL now reads it directly instead, in Home, menus and the quick menu.
- The quick menu checks that it really appeared. If a full-screen game or Xbox mode keeps it hidden, NSXL minimises the game so the menu shows. Closing the menu brings the game back.

**Xbox mode**
- New: Settings › System › **Open with Xbox mode**. iCUE is found automatically and opens (in the tray) whenever Windows starts NSXL in Xbox mode. You can add any other app too.
